case: multi-injector-chain
about: Xray JSON template with a remnawave injector: every visible host gets its own config with itself as 'proxy', the hidden relay as 'relay' (selectFrom HIDDEN, tagRegex ^RELAY$) and the other EXIT hosts as 'exit', 'exit-2' (sameTagAsRecipient); a leastPing balancer over the prefixes proxy and exit with fallbackTag proxy, burstObservatory over the same prefixes. Two exits carry sockopt.dialerProxy 'relay': a chain through a host of the same list.
source: refs/remnawave-backend 6853666, generators unchanged (see README.md for the stubs)
templates: XRAY_JSON = templates/xray-injector.json; SINGBOX = default (DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_SINGBOX) (keys in jsonb order, as the panel serves them from the database)
hosts passed: links/singbox 3 of 4, xray-json 4 of 4 (the hosts query drops hidden hosts except for XRAY_JSON/MIHOMO, and disabled hosts always)

links (XrayGeneratorService): 3 link(s); extended client: same output
xray-json (XrayJsonGeneratorService): 3 config(s); extended client: same output
singbox (SingBoxGeneratorService): 3 host outbound(s) after the template's 2

  links:     not passed: hidden host (the hosts query drops hidden hosts for XRAY_BASE64; subscription.service.ts:259-266)

  singbox:   not passed: hidden host (the hosts query drops hidden hosts for SINGBOX; subscription.service.ts:259-266)
